R0229.title: SBOM Absence Hiding Vulnerability Impact
R0229.definition: The organization cannot quickly determine whether newly disclosed vulnerabilities affect its products or supplier deliveries.
R0229.description:
SBOM absence prevents organizations from knowing which open source components, versions, and transitive dependencies exist in products, images, and supplier deliverables. When a new vulnerability is disclosed, teams cannot quickly determine exposure.

In multi-product and supplier-heavy environments, component invisibility slows response and weakens customer assurance, compliance evidence, and patch prioritization.
R0229.influence: Without a component inventory, vulnerability impact analysis and patch response are delayed, leaving high-risk dependencies in production.
